verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a public OpenAPI spec and REST API for managing resources. However, no evidence shows an endpoint that returns the GPU machine-type catalog with live pricing or live availability. The only availability material is a static docs page about CPU machines in all regions, and pricing appears only as marketing claims ("save up to 70%"), so the story's core capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability from a public or documented endpoint before committing any spend
